og.alt: Validation: Write it like Zod. It won all 12 cells of our workload bench. 12 / 12 cells won on a multi-schema workload against Zod, Valibot and ArkType.

hero.alt: Schema: const User = s.object({ email: s.string().email(), age: s.number().int().min(18) }). User.safeParse runs on { email: 'ada@pyreon.dev', age: 17 }: the email check and the integer check pass, min(18) fails, and the result is ok: false with one issue at path age with code too_small, key validate.number.too-small and message 'Must be at least 18'. With age 18 the same call returns ok: true.
